/events: Tail normalized carrier, routable, routes, and manager events from the daemon API.
/list-show: Inspect interfaces, routes, policy rules, and registered hook scripts.
/status: Show daemon health, uptime, and counters via the REST API.
/validate-reload: Validate YAML offline; reload config or dry-run hook scripts safely.
/carrier: Run scripts when link layer goes UP (carrier.d) or DOWN (no-carrier.d).
/manager: React to NetworkManager device activation, disconnect, and manager state.
/routable: Fire when an interface has full L3 connectivity (systemd-networkd or dhclient).
/routes: React to routing-table changes via routes.d hooks.
/config-yaml: Tune backend, monitored interfaces, policy routing, API/metrics, filters, and audit.
/prometheus: Scrape hook and event health metrics for fleet observability.
/rest-api: Query status, interfaces, routes, rules, and events without SSH or ip(8).
